Use-case & requirements notes:
- Workload: chat-focused support assistant with light summarization of tickets. Average prompt length 600-1,200 tokens (system+preset examples+user history).
- Targets: end-to-end response within 1.2s for short replies, streaming responses acceptable for long replies; cost-sensitive (trying to keep monthly infra + API spend < $1k during trial).
- Throughput: low concurrent QPS (peak 3-5 simultaneous conversations).
- Model preferences: open to mid-sized open models (price/cost tradeoff); wants ability to route to smaller quantized variants if cost spikes.
- Routing/fallback: prefer automatic fallback to smaller model on high-latency, but want to avoid quality cliffs.

Primary technical asks from discovery call:
- Why EU users seeing 2x latency? Region choice guidance and how to set region in hosted API.
- Recommended timeout and client-side settings for streaming vs non-streaming.
- Prompt engineering tips for reducing token counts without losing context: prefer prefix caching, moved static instructions to system message, minimize few-shot examples.
- Best practices to measure token-level latency and trace slow inflight requests.

Perf tuning recommendations already shared (summary):
- Region: recommend routing EU traffic to eu-west region; advise DNS/edge config to ensure requests hit closest endpoint. Suggested quick test: compare us-east and eu-west with identical payloads and capture TTFB and last-byte times.
- Timeouts: suggest client read timeout >= 20s for long responses, streaming-friendly connection timeout at 60s; shorten server-side generation timeout to 12-15s for short replies to fail fast and trigger fallback.
- Prompt length guidance: move static instructions into system message (prefix caching), reduce examples to 1-2 dynamic shots, strip unnecessary context older than 24 hours. Target prompt payload <800 tokens for median cases.
- Streaming: enable streaming when replies exceed 250 tokens; reduces perceived latency and avoids frontend blocking.
- Model selection: start with mid-sized quantized variant (recommended by Redwood for SMB) and enable automatic fallback to smaller quantized profile under high latency.
